name: shopify-checkout-functions
description: A suite of Shopify cart transform functions
summary: This tool is a set of Shopify checkout functions designed to manage cart rules for Alpkit stores. It helps prevent unauthorized free items, enforces bundle pricing rules, restricts shipping options based on destination and product tags, and ensures only one member rewards discount code applies per order. Store admins use it to maintain pricing integrity, control shipping options, and manage discount exclusivity during checkout.
